title: The Other Way Round
prompt: Find a reflection that shows us something we could not otherwise see from where you are standing.
questions: What is real here, and what is reflected?
Which of the two do you want sharp?
What happens if you move one step to the side?
Can you fill the whole frame with the reflection?
Would it be stronger upside down?
technical_reminder: The camera may focus on the glass when you wanted the reflection, or the other way round. Choose which one matters and focus on it deliberately.
safety_note: Watch the traffic and the pavement behind you — reflections put your back to the street.

variation.text: Photograph a puddle so that it is not obvious which way up the photograph should be.

review_prompt: Which photograph uses the reflection most surprisingly?
partner_activity: Partners can guess which way up each photograph was taken.
